verdict.rationale: Stripe's disputes docs say the Dashboard guides merchants through responding to each dispute, and Smart Disputes automates evidence collection and submission for eligible disputes. Terminal payments are managed in the same Dashboard as online payments, so this applies to in-person charges. Chargeback notification is only implied by the generic webhook event mechanism, with no dispute-specific alerts documented. missing for 10: explicit chargeback/dispute notification (dispute events or alerts), documentation of response deadlines, Terminal-specific confirmation for card-present disputes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
